entities.summary: Tadeusz Olechowski was a Polish communist politician, Polish ambassador to various countries from 1960s to 1980s, Minister of Foreign in 1972, viceminister of Foreign Affairs, last minister of foreign affairs of the People's Republic of Poland (1988–1989).
